children: Capitol Federal Financial is splitting operational leadership from its top executive position. John B. Dicus will remain Chairman and CEO while handing off the president role to William "Billy" Skrobacz Jr., effective Oct. 1. Skrobacz currently serves as Executive Vice President and Chief Retail Operations Officer. The move aligns executive structure with the bank's evolving strategic priorities, the company said.  Skrobacz will be responsible for the day-to-day operations of both entities, including oversight of commercial operations, all support functions and setting strategies.
